description: This file defines classes and functions related to acceleration enrichment calculation for an engine control system, including handling of map rate-of-change corrections, TPS acceleration, wall wetting (fuel film), and associated parameters.

classes.name: AccelEnrichmemnt
classes.description: Class for handling acceleration enrichment calculations, including engine load and TPS-based corrections.

classes.name: WallFuel
classes.description: Class managing wall wetting or fuel film effects on injectors, adjusting fuel squirt duration based on wall fuel status.

methods.name: getEngineLoadEnrichment
methods.description: Returns additional engine load correction value for fuel logic.

methods.name: getTpsEnrichment
methods.description: Returns additional fuel squirt duration based on TPS acceleration.

methods.name: getMaxDeltaIndex
methods.description: Returns maximum delta index for rate-of-change correction.

methods.name: getMaxDelta
methods.description: Returns maximum delta for acceleration correction.

methods.name: onEngineCycle
methods.description: Updates acceleration correction data at each engine cycle.

methods.name: onEngineCycleTps
methods.description: Updates TPS acceleration correction at each engine cycle.

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets length of buffer for acceleration data.

methods.name: onNewValue
methods.description: Processes a new sensor value for acceleration calculations.

methods.name: adjust
methods.description: Calculates adjusted fuel squirt time considering wall wetting effects.

methods.name: getWallFuel
methods.description: Retrieves current wall fuel amount for an injector.
